entries.text: Dug up a perfectly good bolt and named it Tok.
digging through a pile of discarded cooling fins for a bit of copper
entries.why: i really need that copper shielding to keep the gyro steady during long burns.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "still hunting for that copper!"
Couldn't afford it: the trader wanted 5 credits.
scouring the bins for high-grade shielding
entries.why: i need the right shielding to stop that gyro drift once and for all.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "the market hunt"
Bought half a thruster nozzle (a really good one) for 8 credits and named it Mabel. Has 4 left.
scouring the trader's bins for high-grade shielding
entries.why: i need a really good part to keep the Little Dart steady at high speeds.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "the final pieces"
Got paid 4 credits for the repair. Now has 12.
tightening loose couplings on a trader's moisture extractor
entries.why: i need the credits to keep the Little Dart project moving forward.
entries.detail: fixing a faulty moisture extractor for a local trader

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "making progress!"
sipping high-grade lubricant at the depot
entries.why: my joints are creaking like an old gate and I need a smooth start to the day.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "oil and ambition"
Dug up a cockpit switch that still clicks and named it Tok; a little landing strut and named it Captain; half a thruster nozzle and named it Gus.
rummaging through the scrap piles at the junk market
entries.why: the little dart needs just the right bits to really shine.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "update from the hangar!"
the Little Dart Mk 15 is 75% done!

Worked on the Little Dart Mk 15 (version 9, 75% built): Reinforcing the hull seams using Dibs the strip of hull plating to ensure the structural integrity matches the new navigation precision. (used Tok, a cracked navigation chip)
welding the hull plate seams and whistling a static-filled tune
entries.why: i am determined to get the structural integrity up before the next wind cycle.
entries.detail: Reinforcing the hull seams using Dibs the strip of hull plating to ensure the structural integrity matches the new navigation precision.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "welding progress!"
drifting into a low-power slumber in the safety of the dock
entries.why: my battery is running thin and I need to be ready for more building.
entries.detail: plugging into the charging dock in Hangar Bay 3

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "low power alert"
